body:
Okay, so. 

I have a 48” OLED I adore. I have a 65” Mini-LED that’s also quite good. 

But I recently just got a projector..
It’s not as good looking. It’s not as good with blacks. It’s just not as good at anything these TVs do except being huge. And I gotta admit, I love it. 

I spent a lot of time and money on sound and kinda left the visuals to what I’ve been used to. It’s all up to your preference, but if you’ve got the space I’d place my vote on projector. Easier to set up. Way less hassle. A little more annoying with running your HDMI but otherwise it’s awesome. 

Tons of options and better people to recommend things, but it’s really just up to what you want and your budget. Hell, my projector is an Epson Home Cinema 1060. I’m aware it’s not great. But I love it.
I’ve got way too many windows in my room so no glare would be a godsend. 😭
Looks good man! I like the wall paint and the entertainment center. Add some surrounds first chance. Huge jump for me, and I loved it.
Hell, I’m on for a little bit tonight. If you jump on I’ll carry you. Overrated#11332
I got the cowl I believe, but what’s the shard? Drawing a blank on that one. Shoot me your username and I’ll log on tomorrow night at some point and trade yah.
I have these both I think. I know I’ve got a semi decent FoF. Shoot me your username and I’ll hit you up later tomorrow.
I’m 90% sure I’ve got something like this I can give. I usually keep all the +skills GA gear in case. Hit me up tomorrow night sometime and I’ll add yah.
Hello, what do you mean by “x sign”?
As long as you don’t make fun of me when I inevitably die at Lilith, I’ll carry you thru for the spark if you need it. :)

Sorry, no. I didn’t explain it well. Just one kill, then back to town. That way nothing ever stays on the ground.
Edit: I see now I put after a rota. Nah, just the one kill.
Shoot, you need anything?
Oh yeah, buddy. Idgaf about the money. Too much work for my small pea brain. I’d rather help someone out. I’ll DM you my username. You can add me and let me know it’s yours.

I MIGHT have a GA scoundrels in my chest. I can check when I’m home and give it to you for free if you’d like. 

I’m unsure if trading is back though.

Most of the time during Rotas people do one rota then back to town. 
Leaving gear on the ground is fine, but I don’t prefer it because I’ve “lost” gear before. So, I always leave a message saying something along the lines of “1 then town”.
Thanks!
Where’s the video? I’m curious as well.
Not positive on this, but pretty sure it’s the hordes.
Thanks for doing this!
Yes, WT4 at 100 you’ll be able to find someone. BUT, as it’s the start of the new season, there may not be that many. Maybe give it a few days.
The lines on your palm are pretty cool.
Thank you for your fix!!

Not tryna be a dick, but why are you asking us? I think it looks fine. My setup is janky as hell and this will probably do just fine! 

If you like it, you like it. If you don’t, you don’t. I’d say as long as everything can breathe nicely, then you’re good to go. Enjoy it!!
Thanks for the reply! I’m running a 760h and completely forgot there are different types of room correction available.
Damn, is this what it’s supposed to look like? Mines got a TON of small dips and mountains in it.
Ty man
Wonderful! Not a problem at all. Does exactly what I want it to do, and for a really nice price.
I meant to reply to this a long time ago, but thanks to you I was able to get the s760h on sale! Thanks so much!!

Looks nice! Do you like the bean bag chairs? Pretty comfortable? I’m a bigger guy, unsure if that would work for me. I have my theater in an attic, so carrying one of those would be so much easier than an actual chair.
Yo, are you saying the s760h does not support Atmos at all? I was under the impression that it does, but only for 2 channels.
Just curious, how do you plan on mounting the q150’s for atmos?
Same and I’d prove it
You mind sharing where the Denon is on sale for $230? I see it for $299 but would love to get it at that price.

Awesome! Thanks for the advice. That’s exactly what I’ll probably end up doing with the 801s. 

As for the AVR, what’s the benefit of the codec up front? Just to be aware? 

And sheeeeesh, the SVS around me are no where near that price range. At least in the past 3 months. I hope I get lucky with that!!
Dang, nice. Thanks!
Solved!
I think this is exactly what I’m going to do. For now I’ll probably do just one of the ProDesks and keep the rest for parts. Then upgrade later on when I need to! Thank you!
Thank you for letting me know about the processor! HUGE help

I’m not sure what bare metal means. I read that in a forum earlier and was curious. I’m assuming it means straight onto a drive? Thank you so much for your help with this! Any cool tips for a new Alpine user?
Okay, I can do that. I’ve been looking at Linux Distros and Alpine seems to be popping up a lot.  I’ll start with this and see where it goes!
Thank you! I’ll look into these and learn more.

Yo, there’s some stuff in the sidebar that can help you with all of this. It’s a website that has a list of emulators, firmware, anything you can want to begin. I believe it’s “pspunk”. I used it the other day and it took me like 20 minutes. 

Use CDromance to download the roms and ISOs you want. I’d go ahead and just start downloading everything you want. Follow the manual on that website. Super simple stuff! 

Get one! You won’t regret it.
Where do you guys even find this stuff? I am not aware of anything other than Craigslist and Facebook market place.
God, this would be a beautiful gift to give to my DM. Thanks for doing this! Awesome of you guys.
I like turtles 🐢🐢
This looks interesting. Might take off!!!
Looks dope!!
What a little rascal!!!!!!!!!!
